raw_text: To get the digest bundle reliably into Google Drive cloud storage, the inline MCP upload tool was rejected because it re-sends the full content as tokens on every upload — the wrong economic shape for something done on every bundle. Instead rclone was installed locally with a one-time OAuth authorization, wrapped in a single publish_drive command. A practical constraint surfaced: rclone can only reach "My Drive," not the Drive "Computers" section, so the digest is synced there and verified against local copies to confirm nothing was actually lost.
